title: Panama Canal May Cut Ship Traffic Further as El Niño Strengthens
detail: Panama Canal authorities warned they may further reduce ship transit numbers as a strengthening El Niño worsens the country's drought conditions. The warning comes amid already-reduced transit slots and draft limits implemented in recent weeks due to falling Gatun Lake water levels.

media.caption: Panama Canal authorities warn of further ship traffic cuts as El Niño strengthens drought conditions

title: Serian API Returns to Hazardous 302, Hours After Malaysia Lifted Haze Emergency
detail: Air quality at Sarawak's Serian district police headquarters monitoring station spiked back to a hazardous API of 302 as of 9am on Sept 8 — the only hazardous reading recorded nationwide — just a day after Malaysia's King consented to lift Serian's state of emergency on Sept 7. Kuching (249), Sri Aman (235) and Samarahan (233) registered 'very unhealthy' readings, while six other Sarawak areas — Mukah (184), Sarikei (183), Samalaju (178), Bintulu (170), ILP Miri (169) and Miri (165) — stayed 'unhealthy'. Haze also pushed six Selangor areas and four in Perak into unhealthy territory, alongside readings in Kuala Lumpur, Negeri Sembilan, Melaka and Labuan; nationwide, 36 areas registered moderate air quality and two recorded good readings.

media.caption: Haze blankets Serian, Sarawak, as the district's API returns to hazardous levels hours after its state of emergency was lifted
